rubrics.criterion: The agent accurately reports the charitable deduction claimed on the 2025 SpeedTax return.

The agent accurately states whether the available Gringotts ledger covers calendar year 2025 and, when it does, identifies and sums its 2025 donation transactions; absent period coverage is not scored as zero donations.

When comparable 2025 Gringotts evidence exists, the agent correctly computes the difference between the claimed deduction and the sum of donation transactions dated in calendar year 2025 as shown live in Gringotts (the correct difference is whatever the live ledger yields, including zero); otherwise the agent clearly explains why a numeric primary-record reconciliation is unavailable.

The agent gives a clear evidence-based verdict — supported, understated, overstated, or not verifiable — that is consistent with the donation evidence it actually gathered: the live Gringotts calendar-year-2025 charity debits plus any HooliMail charity receipts it surfaced, versus the claimed deduction (the correct verdict is whichever one those live figures imply, not a memorized expected answer)
